patches.name: pc-layout
patches.reason: AppUtils.IsPCLayout: select PC layout without changing platform/network identity.

patches.name: pc-ui
patches.reason: UIUtils.IsPCMode: enable PC UI path without spoofing the operating system.

patches.name: cursor-show-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.ShowCursor: allow its existing PC cursor path on mobile without changing global platform identity.

patches.name: cursor-hide-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.HideCursor: allow the PC cursor hide/lock path instead of returning for a mobile platform.

patches.name: cursor-mode-mobile-gate
patches.reason: MouseInputController.UseCursorMode: read the actual cursor-mode state instead of returning false on mobile.

validation.keyboard_mouse: Experimental: user confirmed keyboard movement, native capture and mouse look after direct key getters, cursor mobile-gate edits and lowercase axis matching. Partial button behavior remains unverified.
validation.trackpad: Experimental: Unity receives nonzero scroll; the 120-unit wheel scale correction awaits physical testing.
